what: The consumer scripts/lighthouse.mjs launches Chrome before its try/finally, so a Chrome launch failure (missing system libraries) leaves the detached astro preview server running and the task hangs instead of exiting 1.
tell: lighthouse: FAILED - Error: connect ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:<port>, then the process never exits
proposed_change: Move the launch inside the try so the finally block kills the preview group.
